//go:build linux && amd64

package syscall

import "unsafe"

const GomadPointerVariants = 4

func GomadPointerSockaddr(p *RawSockaddrAny) (Sockaddr, error) { return anyToSockaddr(p) }

func GomadPointerWritev(fd int, p *Iovec, variant int) (uintptr, Errno) {
	switch variant {
	case 0:
		n, _, errno := Syscall(SYS_WRITEV, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2)
		return n, errno
	case 1:
		n, _, errno := Syscall6(SYS_WRITEV, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2, 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	case 2:
		n, _, errno := RawSyscall(SYS_WRITEV, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2)
		return n, errno
	case 3:
		n, _, errno := RawSyscall6(SYS_WRITEV, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), 2, 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	default:
		panic("invalid pointer fixture variant")
	}
}

func GomadPointerPair(fd int, p *RawSockaddrAny, length *uint32, operation string, variant int) (uintptr, Errno) {
	op := uintptr(SYS_ACCEPT)
	switch operation {
	case "accept", "accept-null", "accept-mismatch":
	case "sockname", "sockname-short":
		op = SYS_GETSOCKNAME
	case "peername", "peername-short":
		op = SYS_GETPEERNAME
	default:
		panic("invalid pointer fixture operation")
	}
	switch variant {
	case 0:
		n, _, errno := Syscall(op, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)))
		return n, errno
	case 1:
		n, _, errno := Syscall6(op, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	case 2:
		n, _, errno := RawSyscall(op, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)))
		return n, errno
	case 3:
		n, _, errno := RawSyscall6(op, uintptr(fd), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0, 0, 0)
		return n, errno
	default:
		panic("invalid pointer fixture variant")
	}
}

func GomadPointerOption(fd, name int, p *int32, length *uint32, variant int) (uintptr, Errno) {
	switch variant {
	case 1:
		n, _, errno := Syscall6(SYS_GETSOCKOPT, uintptr(fd), SOL_SOCKET, uintptr(name), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0)
		return n, errno
	case 3:
		n, _, errno := RawSyscall6(SYS_GETSOCKOPT, uintptr(fd), SOL_SOCKET, uintptr(name), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(p)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(length)), 0)
		return n, errno
	default:
		panic("getsockopt requires a six-argument route")
	}
}
